Aloe Blacc with Randal Fisher (saxophone); Chris Bautista (trumpet) live at the NSJ Sunday 08 July 2012.

images.caption: The Marksburg (seen from the western riverside of the Rhine) is a fortress above the town of Braubach in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. It is located on a schist rock in a heigth of 160 m. It is the only medieval castle of the Middle Rhine that has never been destroyed. Since 2002, the castle is one of the principal sites of the UNESCO World Heritage Rhine Gorge.
